title: Sibyl
description: A client-side mod allowing for more control over the user's instance.
body:
# Sibyl!
Sibyl is a fully client-sided mod aiming to give the user more control over aspects of the Minecraft client.

So far, Sibyl allows for: 
- Enabling/disabling specific hud elements.
- Changing the Minecraft window title.
- Changing the "You Died!" screen message.
- Showing of coordinates without F3.
- Changing the base Minecraft splash text.
- Changing the Title Screen's panorama spin speed higher than it should be.

With more to come!

# DISCLAIMER
Sibyl does not **AT ALL** edit your window, apart from the custom window title. This mod does not create, edit, or delete files on your computer.
